prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: five-form character reference sheet for Tupi Battle Grounds, a professional low-poly medieval fantasy strategy game. One single wide horizontal sheet, five full-body versions of THE SAME champion side by side, ordered BASE, A1, A2, B1, B2. Same front three-quarter view and ground line, generous separation, dark desaturated navy studio background, soft warm key light, crisp flat-shaded polygon planes, readable anatomy and equipment. No text or labels or watermark. Each figure has a thin blue circular foot ring, no pedestal. Intrinsic costume colors are independent of team. Base: slender upright shark-faced duelist with swept-back head fin, two short crescent nacre forearm blades pointing down, narrow dark violet sash, exposed pale sea-green chest and asymmetric fin greaves. B1 and B2 use darker sea-plum material and asymmetric extra weapon fins; B2 has one restrained seafoam luminous artifact. Evolution must preserve the recognizable species, face and weapon family; tier one about 8 percent larger and tier two about 16 percent larger. Give each form distinctly authored equipment, never just recolor. Keep all equipment compact within the adjacent-unit spacing. Aquatic ancient civilization walking on land, no modern tech, no generic human heads, no orc tusks, no insect antennae. Low-poly model-sheet quality consistent across all nine champions.
